name: Anna Symmes Harrison
bioAdditions: Each connecting generation is now sourced from Akerly's Tuthill genealogy (S1) and Hayes's Wells genealogy (S3): John Tuthill (1635-1717, 12 generations above John) -> Henry Tuthill 'the Justice' (b. 1 May 1665, d. 4 Jan 1750; m. Bethia Horton, daughter of Capt. Jonathan Horton and Bethia, daughter of William Wells) -> Henry (b. 1690, d. 1 Sep 1775) -> Henry (b. before Dec 1715, d. 17 Sep 1793; m. 16 Mar 1738 Phoebe Horton) -> Anna Tuthill (m. John Cleves Symmes) -> Anna. Akerly states outright: 'Henry's grand-da., Anna Symmes, m. President Wm. Henry Harrison, and was the grandmother of President Benjamin Harrison.' Result: 4th cousin 7 times removed via Tuthill and 5th cousin 6 times removed via William Wells, both confirmed generation by generation in compiled sources. A third, conditional route: both Bethia Horton and Phoebe Horton descend from Barnabas Horton, whom Round 3 places 13 generations above John through Rachel Browne (probable); that would add 5C7R twice. Wikipedia (S2) notes she was the only First Lady never to visit the capital during her husband's presidency.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Path from John Tuthill (1635) and from William Wells is now fully sourced; the remaining dependency is the James -> John Tuthill (c.1730) link in John's own line (Round 2-3).

funFacts: Both First Ladies of the 1840 'Tippecanoe and Tyler Too' ticket are John's cousins: Anna through the Tuthills and Wellses, Julia Gardiner Tyler through Bull Smith.
